arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Calendar years 1969-1971 data (from Treasury Bulletin 1972)
redemptions_1969 = 76
redemptions_1970 = 154
redemptions_1971 = 124

sales_accrued_1969 = 366
sales_accrued_1970 = 191
sales_accrued_1971 = 27

total_redemptions = redemptions_1969 + redemptions_1970 + redemptions_1971
total_sales_accrued = sales_accrued_1969 + sales_accrued_1970 + sales_accrued_1971

ratio = total_redemptions / total_sales_accrued

print(f'Total Redemptions (1969-1971): {total_redemptions}')
print(f'Total Sales plus Accrued Discount (1969-1971): {total_sales_accrued}')
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(ratio, 2)}')
"
